items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in São João do Polêsine (RS) is procuring vehicles, transport or related equipment and services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 80,635; proposals close Nov 27, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
